_doc: RoboPaint lettering targets (臨摹 of engraved English round hand). targets: [slug, text, structure (word: a single (flourished) word | line: several words on one line)] (difficulty extreme). Each task's exemplar is its own file (--exemplar <slug>.exemplar.json), made by scripts/robopaint_lettering/lt_exemplar.py from a public-domain scan (spec: scripts/robopaint_lettering/exemplars.json): the scan's ink re-drawn with the task's pointed pen, its regions (at most 30 mm along the strokes) and one writing route per connected piece of ink (the contact cap). sources: the README's Sources text per slug ("*" = the default); licence: the exemplar record written into the graders' truth and target.png's PNG comment (licences[slug] overrides it); notices: the NOTICE-exemplar.md texts (agent's / graders' copies). Every text is checked by ci_checks/check-robopaint-leak.sh like every README sentence.
targets: Aim at improvement in every line.

sources.liberty: George Bickham, *The Universal Penman* (London, 1741), engraved plates of English round hand after the writing masters named on each plate; scan: Getty Research Institute, Internet Archive item gri_33125008538056 (https://archive.org/details/gri_33125008538056; possible-copyright-status NOT_IN_COPYRIGHT; the same book on Wikimedia Commons as a DjVu file under {{PD-scan}}). Public domain: the plates were engraved 1733-1741 (Bickham d. 1758) and the scan is a faithful reproduction of a public-domain two-dimensional work. This exemplar: the flourished heading 'Liberty.' of the plate numbered 4 that opens 'Liberty' (page n222 of the scan, G. Brooks scripsit), the word with all its flourishes, placed 205 mm wide on the sheet.
